title: Fix GatherItemDecompose over-mining (P1 audit finding)
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit: GatherItemDecompose adds 7 MineBlock actions per source block type without deducting expected yield from inventory projections. Mining 7 oak_logs when only 3 are needed wastes agent time and inventory space. Track per-block expected yield and adjust target count dynamically. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P1-001)
